info.title: Taskelith execution API
info.description: Worker enrollment, the public installation CA that a worker checks before it enrolls (G3 sub-change 26b), launch authorization (G2 decision D12 (a)), delegation and its result, task results, evidence with its retirement, the reconciliation queue and re-admission, and the delivery of slot and per-run SCM credentials to a worker (G3 sub-change 9c). Worker operations use the per-worker credential. Operator operations use the installation bootstrap credential (G2 decision D10 (a)); since 9c the evidence, reconciliation, and re-admission operations also accept the browser session of the control-plane document.

get.summary: Read the installation CA certificate, which a worker checks against its enrollment fingerprint
get.description: Public: it declares no credential and answers the certificate only, never key material. A worker trusts the answer only when its SHA-256 equals the fingerprint of its enrollment bundle.

delete.summary: Retire an evidence record after its minimum retention
delete.description: A `project-maintainer` on the record's project removes the record once 365 days have passed since its publication (`publishedAt`), then its content once no record refers to the digest (G2 `implement-evidence-store` decision Q2). The record is read before the role, as for `readEvidence`: a principal that may not read it gets the 404 of an unknown record, and a reader below `project-maintainer` gets 403.

204.description: The record is retired. Its content is removed with it or, when that removal fails, later by the sweep of unreferenced digests; the record stays retired.

403.description: The principal reads the record but is not a `project-maintainer` of its project, or a session request carried no valid CSRF token; nothing took effect.

404.description: The evidence record does not exist, was already retired, or the principal holds no role that reads it.

422.description: The minimum retention has not passed; the record is unchanged.

500.description: The control plane failed before the record was removed; nothing took effect.

503.description: The database is not available; nothing took effect.

post.summary: Re-admit a task at its next ownership generation
post.description: A `project-operator` or above on the project named in the query re-admits a task of that project whose last attempt ended, through the writer of admissions (G2 `rebindAdmission`); the new admission is bound at the task's next ownership generation. The role is checked on the named project before the run or the task is read (control-plane wire contracts section 2). A repeat with the same `readmissionId` and input returns the first 201.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The project of the run, on which the role is checked before the run or the task is read.

201.description: The task is re-admitted with its new admission, or a repeat of the same `readmissionId` and input returns the first answer.

400.description: The path, the query, or the body is not valid.

401.description: No valid session cookie or operator credential was presented.

403.description: The principal holds no role of `project-operator` or above on the named project, or a session request carried no valid CSRF token; nothing took effect.

404.description: The project, the run, or the task does not exist, or the run is not of the named project.

409.description: The task's ownership generation is no longer the expected one, or the `readmissionId` was used with another input; nothing took effect.

422.description: The task cannot be re-admitted now; nothing took effect.

500.description: The control plane failed; nothing is assumed to have taken effect.

get.summary: Fetch the credential of a reserved slot for an execution
get.description: Slot credential delivery of account pool contract sections 7 and 7.3, first and repeated: after its launch authorization, and again whenever it starts or adopts the execution, the worker that owns the execution fetches the credential of a slot that the reservation of the execution's attempt names. The control plane finds the execution by the `attemptId` of the query and the `executionId` of the path, because an execution identifier is unique only within its task. An `authorized` execution with no earlier delivery also needs its launch grant unexpired and not `revoked` (section 7); for any other execution the ownership checks of section 7.3 stand in. The first fetch returns the slot's current credential version; a later fetch re-delivers that version. `LaunchGrant` carries no credential. The response is never cached, and a log of the request never holds its body.

parameters.name: executionId
parameters.description: The execution, whose attempt holds the run's reservation.

parameters.name: slotId
parameters.description: A slot that the reservation of the execution's attempt names.

parameters.name: ownershipGeneration
parameters.description: The ownership generation the worker holds the attempt at.

parameters.name: recoveryEpoch
parameters.description: The recovery epoch of the worker.

200.description: The slot credential for the execution, at the first or a later fetch.

Cache-Control.description: Always `no-store`, so that no cache keeps the credential.

400.description: The path or the query is not valid.

422.description: The delivery is refused, an unknown attempt or execution with `assignment-not-active`; nothing is revealed.

500.description: The control plane failed; nothing is assumed to have taken effect.

503.description: The credential store or the database is not available.

post.summary: Obtain the current per-run SCM credential of a run
post.description: The worker that holds an attempt of a task of the run obtains the run's current SCM credential version. The control plane issues the first one when the run has none, serialized per run, so that of concurrent first issues one issues and the others return its version; a repeat with no refresh between returns the same version, and one after a refresh the refreshed version. After the ownership checks of launch authorization contract section 9, every call re-checks the bound remote URL against the SCM integration's current allowed origin. The response is never cached, and a log never holds its body.

200.description: The run's current SCM credential version.

Cache-Control.description: Always `no-store`, so that no cache keeps the credential.

400.description: The path or the body is not valid.

422.description: No credential is issued or revealed, an unknown run with `assignment-not-active`; the control plane records the reason.

500.description: The control plane failed; nothing is assumed to have taken effect.

503.description: The credential store, the database, or the SCM service is not available.

get.summary: Fetch one version of a run's SCM credential
get.description: The worker fetches the version that a refresh notice names (G3 sub-change 9d). A version is written once and never changes. After the ownership checks of launch authorization contract section 9, every fetch re-checks the bound remote URL against the SCM integration's current allowed origin. The response is never cached, and a log never holds its body.

parameters.name: ownershipGeneration
parameters.description: The ownership generation the worker holds the attempt at.

parameters.name: recoveryEpoch
parameters.description: The recovery epoch of the worker.

200.description: That version of the run's SCM credential.

Cache-Control.description: Always `no-store`, so that no cache keeps the credential.

400.description: The path or the query is not valid.

404.description: Once the ownership and remote checks pass, the run has no such credential or version.

422.description: Nothing is revealed, an unknown run with `assignment-not-active`; the control plane records the reason.

workerCredential.description: The control-plane credential issued at enrollment.

browserSession.name: __Host-taskelith-session
browserSession.description: The server-side session identifier, 256 random bits, in a cookie set with `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`, and `Path=/`, without `Domain`. The `__Host-` prefix makes the browser refuse the cookie without `Secure` and `Path=/` or with `Domain`; `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Strict` rest on the server alone. Never readable by scripts and never in a response body.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: The CSRF token of the session that the cookie names, required with the cookie on every operation other than GET; compared in constant time.

Identifier.description: An opaque identifier of 1-128 printable ASCII characters without whitespace.

Instant.description: A UTC time in the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ.

ContentDigest.description: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

Generation.description: A compare-and-set generation that starts at 1.

DisplayText.description: Text shown to people and never interpreted, without control characters.

ArtifactRevision.description: An immutable revision of a workflow artifact, identified by artifact and digest.

ProtocolVersion.description: The execution protocol version. A worker executes a command only if it supports the version the command names; the current version is 1.

ProtocolVersionWindow.description: The inclusive range of execution protocol versions a party supports; minimum is at most maximum.

RecoveryEpoch.description: The installation recovery epoch, which starts at 1 and changes when PostgreSQL is restored.

HardControl.description: A resource control a task policy can require as hard.

WorkerCapacity.description: Capacity a worker declares at enrollment and whenever it changes.

ExitStatus.description: An exit code, a terminating signal, or an unknown status.

Failure.description: A kernel failure: callers branch on the code, never on the message.

EnrollmentRequest.description: Presented with a single-use enrollment token, after the worker claimed its data root and before it creates its journal, which takes the journalId named here.

Enrollment.description: The worker identity and credentials. The content of both credentials is defined by enrollment (G2 item 13).

protocolVersions.description: The protocol versions the control plane assigns in.

controlPlane.description: Secret bearer credential for the worker operations.

broker.description: Secret NATS user credentials (G2 decision D9 (a)).

LaunchAuthorizationRequest.description: The expected values; the worker is the authenticated principal, never a field.

operationId.description: Journaled before the first request; a transport retry repeats it.

reportsNotStarted.description: The supervisor launch record of this execution shows that no spawn was claimed; required to authorize the same execution again.

reportsNotStartedFor.description: Every earlier execution of the attempt that the worker sealed and has not seen confirmed, oldest first; the authority applies them in this order.

SealedExecution.description: An earlier execution of the attempt whose launch record the worker sealed; the authority records its not-started before the ownership rule, in the same transaction.

operationId.description: The last operation the worker journaled as granted for that execution, else its last operation.

LaunchGrant.description: A granted authorization and the values it binds.

issuedAt.description: The database clock; the worker never compares it with its own clock.

LaunchRejection.description: A rejection is retryable exactly for quarantined and unavailable; a retry uses a new operationId.

LaunchAuthorizationOutcome.description: The decision recorded for the operationId: a grant, a rejection, or, on a transport retry, a revoked or expired grant.

AttemptOutcome.description: How the attempt ended. It does not accept the task's work.

cancelled.description: Whether cancellation was requested before the attempt ended.
Whether cancellation was requested before the attempt ended.
Whether cancellation was requested before the attempt ended.

TaskResult.description: Pending until an attempt of the task ends; then the outcome fact of its last ended attempt, at the ownership generation that attempt ended in, and the evidence published for the task.

Admission.description: A task admission record. A used admission carries the ownership generation of the dispatch that used it.

DelegationRequest.description: Creates a child task of the delegating attempt, which the worker owns at ownershipGeneration; the parent is derived from the attempt, never named.

delegationId.description: Chosen by the worker; a repeat returns the current state of the delegation.

runId.description: The run the child is bound to.

child.description: The child task, as SDLC admission takes it.

DelegationOutcome.description: An admitted child, a delegation that waits for capacity, or a rejection with its capacity reservation reason.

EvidencePublication.description: An evidence record as its producer publishes it.

evidenceId.description: Chosen by the producer, so that a retried publication cannot create a second record.

ownershipGeneration.description: The ownership generation the producer held the attempt at.

kind.description: What the evidence is, such as an execution log or a validator report.

codeRevision.description: The code revision the evidence is about.

validator.description: The validator, reviewer, or producing program and its version.

outcome.description: The outcome the evidence records, defined by its kind.

EvidenceRecord.description: A stored evidence record. The producer is the authenticated principal that published it.

evidenceId.description: Chosen by the producer, so that a retried publication cannot create a second record.

ownershipGeneration.description: The ownership generation the producer held the attempt at.

kind.description: What the evidence is, such as an execution log or a validator report.

codeRevision.description: The code revision the evidence is about.

validator.description: The validator, reviewer, or producing program and its version.

outcome.description: The outcome the evidence records, defined by its kind.

ownershipCurrent.description: False for evidence published at an older ownership generation, which is kept for audit only.

QuarantineRecord.description: A message the broker gave up on or a consumer terminated, copied with its diagnostics (item 12).

sequence.description: The record's sequence in the quarantine stream.

bodyExpired.description: The original expired from its stream before the capture, so the record cannot be redriven.

next.description: The sequence to read the next page from; absent on the last page.

messageId.description: The new Nats-Msg-Id, `<original>.redrive.<n>`; absent for a message without one.

InstallationCa.description: The public certificate of the installation CA (G3 item 26), which the worker pins after it checks its SHA-256 against the enrollment bundle.

certificate.description: One PEM certificate block and nothing else.

AuthenticationFailure.description: Status 401: `unauthenticated` when no valid session cookie or operator credential was presented, `login-failed` when a login name and password do not match, without saying which.

AccessDenial.description: Status 403: the authenticated principal lacks the role the operation requires.

CsrfRejection.description: Status 403: a mutation authenticated by the session cookie carried no `X-CSRF-Token` header, or one that is not its session's token; nothing took effect.

ExternalId.description: An identifier that an external service issues, compared exactly and never parsed (source control contract section 2, rule 3).

RemoteUrl.description: A bound remote URL: HTTPS with a host name and an optional port from 1 to 65535, without IPv6 literal, user information, query, or fragment, which a workspace clones from and pushes to (git workspace contract sections 3 and 7), so that no secret can be part of it. Its origin is the allowed origin of the binding's SCM integration when it was bound.

RetentionRefusal.description: Status 422 of `retireEvidence`: the record's minimum retention of 365 days after its publication (`publishedAt`) has not passed; `details.retainedUntil` names the end of the retention.

retainedUntil.description: The end of the retention, 365 days after `publishedAt` (`retentionEndsAt`).

DelegationResultOutcome.description: A delegated child's outcome in a delegation result (`DELEGATION_OUTCOMES`).

DelegationSummary.description: The summary of a delegated child task for its parent, at most `MAX_HARNESS_TEXT_LENGTH` characters; text of the child's run, redacted as that run's text is.

DelegationResult.description: The result of a delegation: pending until the child task ends or the delegation is rejected, then its outcome and summary.

childTaskId.description: The child task that the delegation request named.
The child task that the delegation request named.

UnknownExecution.description: An execution whose running is not known (G2 `isUnknownExecution`): it keeps its attempt's ownership and capacity until a terminal fact or an operator resolves it.

ownershipGeneration.description: The task's ownership generation that the attempt holds.

evidence.description: Every evidence entry of the execution, unbounded as `withEvidence` keeps it; at least one is of a kind other than `cancellation-not-applied` (`isUnknownExecution`).

UnknownExecutionPage.description: Unknown executions of a project in the order of `UnknownExecutionCursor`.

next.description: The position of the page's last item, whose fields the caller passes as `afterTaskId` and `afterExecutionId`; absent on the last page.

UnknownExecutionCursor.description: A position in the unknown executions of a project: an execution identifier is unique only within its task, so the order is by task identifier, then execution identifier, in code-unit order.

UnrecordedProcess.description: A populated containment that a worker reported without an execution record (`execution.unrecorded-process`); it names no project or task.

UnrecordedProcessPage.description: Unrecorded processes in the order of `UnrecordedProcessCursor`.

next.description: The position of the page's last item, whose fields the caller passes as `afterWorkerId` and `afterObservationId`; absent on the last page.

UnrecordedProcessCursor.description: A position in the unrecorded processes: an observation identifier is unique only per worker (`unrecorded_processes` key), so the order is by worker identifier, then observation identifier, in code-unit order.

Readmission.description: Re-admits a task at its next ownership generation; compare-and-set on the generation the caller read, and idempotent by `readmissionId` (product ports contract section 2, rule 7).

readmissionId.description: The caller's idempotency key of this re-admission, scoped to the task.

expectedOwnershipGeneration.description: The task's current ownership generation as the caller read it.

ReadmissionRefusal.description: Status 422 of `readmitTask`, checked in this order: an attempt of the task is still active, an unknown execution included; the task's current admission has not been dispatched, so placement still owns it; or SDLC admission refuses the new admission, for example because a prerequisite stage has not passed.

RevealedSlotCredential.description: A slot credential revealed to the run that reserved the slot. Secret: only in the response of `fetchSlotCredential`, never cached, logged, journaled, or written to disk (account pool contract sections 7 and 7.3).

SlotCredentialDelivery.description: The credential of a slot that the execution's reservation names, at the version the slot record names; the first and every later delivery to the same execution and slot carry the same version (account pool contract section 8.1).

mechanismId.description: The admitted delivery mechanism, such as `subscription-token`.

SlotCredentialRefusal.description: Status 422 of `fetchSlotCredential`, at the first fetch or a later one, checked in the order of account pool contract section 7.3: the ownership reasons of launch authorization contract section 9, with `assignment-not-active` also for an unknown attempt or execution, after the installation and worker checks; `execution-conflict` for an execution that is not the owning one, is terminal, or has a `revoked` grant, or that is `authorized` with no earlier delivery and an expired grant; `capacity-not-reserved` for a reservation that is released, held for another attempt, or does not name the slot; then the slot's ineligibility (`revoked`, `removed`); then `delivery-not-admitted`, which section 7.3 names `invalid`, for a mechanism without an admitted delivery for its harness. Nothing is revealed.

ScmPermission.description: A permission of a per-run SCM credential (`SCM_PERMISSIONS`, source control contract section 3).

ScmCredentialRequest.description: The attempt the worker holds; the worker is the authenticated principal, never a field.

RevealedScmSecret.description: The secret of a per-run SCM credential. Secret: only in a credential delivery response, never cached, logged, or stored (source control contract section 3).

ScmAuthorization.description: The complete `Authorization` header value that the SCM plugin forms from the secret (git workspace contract section 7). As secret as the secret itself.

ScmCredentialDelivery.description: One version of a run's SCM credential, with the remote URL it may be sent to. A version never changes once issued; a refresh issues the next version.

version.description: Numbers the secrets issued for the credential: 1 at issue, one more at each refresh.

remoteUrl.description: The bound remote URL that the issue re-checked; the worker sends the credential only to it.

ScmCredentialRefusal.description: Status 422 of `issueRunScmCredential` and `fetchRunScmCredential`, checked in this order: the ownership reasons of launch authorization contract section 9, with `assignment-not-active` also for an unknown run or an attempt not of a task of the run, after the installation and worker checks; the project has no repository binding; the bound remote URL is not HTTPS, holds user information, a query, or a fragment, or its normalized origin is not the SCM integration's current allowed origin; then the version's secret has ended: for a fetch, the named version by a refresh, a revocation, or its expiry, and for an issue, the run's current version by a revocation or its expiry. Nothing is issued or revealed, and `message` and `details` name only the reason and identifiers, never a URL or a secret.
